Cookies

No advertising cookies

The site sets no advertising or analytics cookies. Videos are served directly by the site, without an embedded third-party player.

Anonymous, cookie-free analytics

To improve the site, CODEM anonymously measures pages viewed, clicks on action buttons (quote, call, callback) and quote-form steps. A temporary visit ID is kept in the browser tab and deleted when it closes. No IP address, name or identifying data is stored, and the data is not shared. It is kept for 13 months at most.

Your choice remains accessible

Accept all and Reject all are available in privacy preferences at the bottom of every page. Reject all turns analytics off. Your choice is stored locally under codem-privacy.
